decision.message: The source-referenced extraction could not be validated; no board was generated.

clauses.text: Please make a BMP280 board using the low_current profile: 10k I2C pull-ups, a 100 kHz bus and 100 pF total capacitance. I only mean reducing pull-up current, not whole-board power or battery operation. Use the normal reviewed operating limits.
